config.manual_labour.option.decorative_t: How far to the side a rested Pestle or Ladle is offset from the Mortar's center.
Tilt angle, in degrees, of a Pestle or Ladle rested decoratively on the Mortar.
Vertical position of a Pestle or Ladle rested decoratively on the Mortar.
config.manual_labour.option.item_pile_ra: How far from the center items scatter when piled inside the Mortar.
Vertical position of items piled inside the Mortar, relative to the block's base.
config.manual_labour.option.pestle_tip_c: Vertical offset for where the Pestle's tip appears to touch the contents of the Mortar while grinding.
config.manual_labour.option.use_create_c: Let the Mortar grind items using Create's Crushing Wheel recipes as a fallback when no Manual Labour grinding recipe matches. Disable to rely only on hand-authored mortar_grinding recipes.
config.manual_labour.option.use_create_d: Let the Workstone complete Create's Deployer steps within Sequenced Assembly recipes as a fallback when no Manual Labour workstone recipe matches.
config.manual_labour.option.use_create_m: Let the Mortar grind items using Create's Millstone recipes as a fallback when no Manual Labour grinding recipe matches. Disable to rely only on hand-authored mortar_grinding recipes.
Let the Mortar mix ingredients using Create's Mechanical Mixer recipes as a fallback when no Manual Labour mixing recipe matches. Disable to rely only on hand-authored mortar_mixing recipes.
config.manual_labour.option.use_create_p: Let the Workstone press items with a Hammer using Create's Mechanical Press recipes. Also controls whether the Workstone is shown as a pressing station in JEI.
config.manual_labour.title: Manual Labour Config
manual_labour.ponder.millstone.text_1: The Millstone grinds items down when spun
manual_labour.ponder.millstone.text_2: Standing on top will spin along with it
manual_labour.ponder.millstone.text_3: Throw or insert items on top to feed the Millstone
manual_labour.ponder.millstone.text_4: Once ground, right-click with an empty hand to collect the results
manual_labour.ponder.millstone.text_5: Spinning it too fast will cause it to stop grinding
manual_labour.ponder.mortar.header: Grinding and Mixing in the Mortar
manual_labour.ponder.mortar.text_1: The Mortar grinds and mixes items entirely by hand
manual_labour.ponder.mortar.text_2: Right-click items onto it to add ingredients
manual_labour.ponder.mortar.text_3: Hold right-click with a Pestle to grind, or a Ladle to mix
manual_labour.ponder.mortar.text_4: Each tool wears down a little with every use
manual_labour.ponder.mortar.text_5: Shift-right-click with a Pestle or Ladle to rest it on the Mortar
manual_labour.ponder.mortar.text_6: Fluids can also be poured in or drawn out using buckets and bottles
